nodes.label: OpenRouter
nodes.summary: Model router; Hermes and several products reach most LLMs through it.
details: Since 2026-10-09 every app uses its own key on a NEW account paid by Biglobster LLC (SocialAgenda, FinView, ChatMemo, Hermes, Hermes auditor, WhatsApp bot, local .env files); old-account keys are not revoked yet
The account is restricted from closed-weight Anthropic, Google and OpenAI models (support ticket open since 2026-10-08)

Zero Data Retention is on account-wide and is being replaced by per-request data_collection deny (tasks/openrouter-deny-plan.md in the workspace); ZDR currently leaves qwen3.7-flash and meta/muse-image without a provider
biglobster-osee holds an OpenRouter key but its live code never calls it (the per-role model variables belong to the archived multi-agent design)
